description: Dayze gives ChatGPT memory of your real life. Connect your Dayze account with read-only OAuth and ChatGPT can answer from your actual timeline: what happened this week, who you know, what you spent, what you own, where you're going, and what you've noted down - with source references and a link to inspect every answer in Dayze. Dayze is read-only here: it cannot change, delete, buy, or send anything, and you can inspect or revoke the connection anytime in Dayze Settings. Without an account, Dayze can search a public notable-people catalog (age in days, timeline day numbers, birthday peers).

defaultPrompt: What did I spend at Quantum Mart?
